english.note: Use this shorter form when the context already makes the strong dislike clear.
This is the all-purpose spoken choice for intensely disliking a person or thing.
Use 憎 as the all-purpose colloquial verb for strongly hating or detesting someone or something.
Use this for a stronger, more personal aversion, closer to ‘hate’ than ordinary dislike.

examples.english: I hate rainy days the most.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 hou2 zang1 sik6 jyun4 seoi1

examples.english: I abhor people smoking in the house.
examples.traditional: 我最憎人哋喺屋企食煙。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zang1 jan4 dei6 hai2 uk1 kei2 sik6 jin1

examples.english: I really dislike people who lie.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zan1 hai6 zang1 jan4 dei6 gong2 daai6 waa6
